text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yay, Trai-chan.
Good work at training camp~
choice_data_list: Good work! Wanna get some shaved ice?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh, nice, nice. Thoughtful of you.
Since it's an after-party, let's grab a quick bite.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The final day of summer camp.
We decided to get shaved ice together.
Now, what flavor should we order—
choice_data_list: Do you want strawberry? Or melon?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainer-chan.
There's really only one choice when it comes to shaved ice syrup.
And that is—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Blue Hawaii!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well, there's a deep story behind this.
Back when I was still little...

text_block_list.name: Tran's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Transcend. That shaved ice...
isn't it Blue Hawaii flavored?

text_block_list.name: Tran's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Guess we have different tastes, then...
Blue Hawaii is delicious, though.

text_block_list.name: Young Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Grandma...
I'm sorry, I'm so sorry! I...!

text_block_list.name: Young Transcend
text_block_list.text:
From now on, I'm sticking with Blue Hawaii all the way!
Let's eat the same thing!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
And that's what happened.
Ever since then, it's always been Blue Hawaii for me.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Whenever I try ordering something else, my grandma's sad face pops into my head.
choice_data_list: I see, you really care about your grandmother.
I see, you really care about your grandma, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was quite an endearing story.
It turns out Transcend was pretty much
a grandma's girl.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Now then, we had our shaved ice dessert,
so we're all set to welcome autumn.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
There were no major rivals in the "Leopard Stakes".
However, things wouldn't be so easy moving forward.
And then...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Preparations are solid. Let's analyze our rivals using this device I developed.
choice_data_list: Yeah, leave the camerawork to me!
Yeah, leave the camerawork to me!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look at you, all fired up.
Make sure you capture some great footage for me.
choice_data_list: OK! So I'm both Trainer and director.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Shooting the footage isn't the end of it...
Based on the data cranked out by the Cinema Gun..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I had to devise an even more efficient training plan. The responsibility weighed heavily on me.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Alright, shall we start shooting? Starring me, featuring a star-studded guest cast—a blockbuster racing masterpiece!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Aiming to be this year's No. 1 hit!
...Or something like that.
